facilityDescriptions.clubHouseShort: Main administrative headquarters of your cycling team.
facilityDescriptions.clubHouseLong: The Club House is the core operational base of the team. It supports administration, club organization, and future business growth. Higher levels help unlock broader staff structure and future management systems.
facilityDescriptions.trainingCenterShort: Core training base for rider development and daily coaching work.
facilityDescriptions.trainingCenterLong: The Training Center improves the effectiveness of coaching staff and supports rider training quality, development support, and overload-risk management. Higher levels also expand trainer capacity.
facilityDescriptions.medicalCenterShort: Medical facility for prevention, treatment, recovery, and rider health.
facilityDescriptions.medicalCenterLong: The Medical Center supports Team Doctors, Physios, and Nutritionists. It reduces harsh medical limitations, improves injury prevention and recovery support, and expands medical staff capacity.
facilityDescriptions.youthAcademyShort: Long-term development facility for future riders and youth progression.
facilityDescriptions.youthAcademyLong: The Youth Academy is a strategic long-term investment. It supports youth development systems, unlocks the U23 Head Coach role, and later improves training and development for U23 riders.
facilityDescriptions.mechanicsWorkshopShort: Technical operations base for equipment maintenance and support.
facilityDescriptions.mechanicsWorkshopLong: The Mechanics Workshop improves technical support capacity and prepares the club for deeper equipment systems, repair speed, and maintenance cost reductions. Higher levels unlock additional mechanic slots.
facilityDescriptions.scoutingOfficeShort: Scouting and intelligence center for reports, market information, and talent discovery.
facilityDescriptions.scoutingOfficeLong: The Scouting Office controls scouting report quality cap, scouting capacity, and later market intelligence systems. Higher levels unlock more scout slots and better report-quality ceilings.

tutorial.welcomeBody: We can show you how facilities and team assets work, including upgrades, staff limits, vehicles, bonuses, and construction projects.
tutorial.facilitiesBody:
This is the Infrastructure page.

The Facilities tab shows the buildings your club can own and upgrade. Every team starts with a basic Level 1 Clubhouse.

Later, you can build and upgrade important facilities such as the Training Center, Medical Center, Youth Academy, Mechanics Workshop, and Scouting Office.

Facilities are important because they improve your club and can also define how many staff members you are allowed to have.
tutorial.projectsBody:
When you open the details for a facility, you can see what the next level costs, how long construction takes, and what bonuses or unlocks it will bring.

You can start a build or upgrade project when your club has enough money and available project capacity.

You can also cancel an infrastructure project. If you cancel immediately, you receive a full refund. If you cancel later, the refund can be smaller.
tutorial.assetsBody:
The Assets tab shows vehicles and support assets your team can use.

This includes team cars, team buses, equipment vans, mobile workshops, and medical vans. These assets can support your team during races, travel, preparation, and training camps.

Each asset can have different levels, costs, condition, bonuses, and limits. Open the details for each asset to understand what it brings and how it can help your team perform better.

To use this page fully, some advanced functions, management options, or extended tools may require a Premium account or coin purchase.

level1.name: Basic Club Car
level1.effect: Provides basic race support coverage, mechanical response and feeding support.

level2.name: Reliable Support Car
level2.effect: Improves mechanical response, race-day logistics and basic fatigue protection.

level3.name: Professional Team Car
level3.effect: Improves race support coverage, tactical communication, feeding support and incident response.

level4.name: Elite Support Car
level4.effect: Provides high mechanical response, tactical support, crash/incident response and race-fatigue protection.

level5.name: World-Class Race Support Car
level5.effect: Provides maximum race support quality, mechanical response, tactical communication and incident support.

level1.name: Basic Team Bus
level1.effect: Small fatigue reduction on tours. Minor effect on one-day races.

level2.name: Recovery Team Bus
level2.effect: Good fatigue reduction during stage races and long travel blocks.

level3.name: Elite Tour Bus
level3.effect: Strongest bus fatigue reduction on long tours; limited effect on one-day races.

level1.name: Basic Equipment Van
level1.effect: Small boost to pre-stage equipment readiness and small reduction to mechanical incident time loss.

level2.name: Service Equipment Van
level2.effect: Medium boost to spare-bike response, pre-stage readiness, and equipment condition-loss reduction.

level3.name: Pro Equipment Van
level3.effect: Strong boost to spare-bike response, wheel-change support, and stage-race equipment readiness.

level1.name: Mobile Workshop
level1.effect: Improves repair speed, lowers repair costs, and supports mechanic response during races and tours.

level2.name: Pro Mobile Workshop
level2.effect: Strong repair speed bonus, stronger repair-cost reduction, and better post-race condition recovery.

level1.name: Basic Medical Van
level1.effect: Small medical response bonus, small minor-injury risk reduction, and basic post-stage recovery support.

level2.name: Recovery Medical Van
level2.effect: Medium medical response bonus, stronger minor-injury risk reduction, hydration support, and better recovery after stages.

level3.name: Pro Medical Unit
level3.effect: Strong medical response bonus, best minor-injury risk reduction, heat/hydration support, and strongest post-stage recovery support.

level2.effect: Improves club administration foundation and prepares future sponsor/contract systems.

level3.unlock: Improves club administration, sponsor operations and contract infrastructure.
level3.effect: Future sponsor, contract and organization bonuses can scale from this level.

level4.unlock: Supports a larger professional club organization.
level4.effect: Future commercial and staff-management systems can scale from this level.

level5.effect: Maximum HQ foundation for future elite sponsor, contract and organization bonuses.

level1.unlock: Removes harsh mechanic cap and unlocks second Mechanic slot.
level1.effect: Improves technical support foundation for future equipment and race-service systems.

level2.unlock: Unlocks third Mechanic slot plus 10% faster equipment repair.
level2.effect: Future equipment repairs become faster once the equipment system applies this effect.

level3.unlock: Unlocks fourth Mechanic slot plus 20% faster and 20% cheaper equipment repair.
level3.effect: Future equipment repairs become faster and cheaper.

level4.unlock: Unlocks fifth Mechanic slot plus 30% faster and 30% cheaper equipment repair.
level4.effect: Maximum mechanics-workshop support for equipment maintenance.

level1.unlock: Removes harsh Lv 0 medical cap and unlocks second Physio slot.
level1.effect: Improves medical staff effectiveness for injury prevention, recovery duration and fatigue-floor reduction.

level2.unlock: Unlocks Nutritionist slot plus injury recovery bonuses up to 3%.
level2.effect: Allows Nutritionist contribution and improves return-to-fitness support.

level3.unlock: Unlocks third Physio slot and second Team Doctor slot.
level3.effect: Improves medical capacity and allows stronger combined health/recovery effects.

level4.unlock: Unlocks fourth Physio slot plus injury recovery bonuses up to 5%.
level4.effect: Improves recovery speed and medical depth for high-level squads.

level5.unlock: Unlocks fifth Physio slot plus injury recovery bonuses up to 8%.
level5.effect: Elite medical center with maximum recovery and prevention support.

level1.unlock: Basic scouting setup plus unlocks second Scout / Analyst slot.
level1.effect: Keeps Basic report-quality cap but improves scouting capacity.

level2.unlock: Unlocks third Scout / Analyst slot plus Solid report quality.
level2.effect: Raises scouting report cap to Solid.

level3.unlock: Unlocks fourth Scout / Analyst slot plus Strong report quality.
level3.effect: Raises scouting report cap to Strong.

level4.unlock: Unlocks fifth Scout / Analyst slot plus Elite report quality.
level4.effect: Raises scouting report cap to Elite.

level1.effect: Allows coaching staff to contribute more effectively to training output, development and overload-risk control.

level2.effect: Raises the effective coaching cap for training output and development support.

level3.effect: Allows deeper coaching staff and stronger combined training/development impact.

level4.effect: Raises coaching effect cap for advanced clubs.

level5.effect: Maximum coaching cap for training output, rider development and overload-risk reduction.

level2.effect: U23 riders receive 10% bonus on training and development once the U23 system applies this effect.
